title: Validation and Data-Integration of Yeast-Based Assays for Functional Classification of BRCA1 Missense Variants.
authors: Belle, Francesca; Mercatanti, Alberto; Lodovichi, Samuele; Congregati, Caterina; Guglielmi, Chiara; Tancredi, Mariella; Caligo, Maria Adelaide; Cervelli, Tiziana; Galli, Alvaro
one_liner_zh: 该文验证并整合酵母功能实验对BRCA1错义变体进行致病性分类，纯湿实验功能检测，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Germline mutations in the BRCA1 gene have been reported to increase the lifetime risk of developing breast and/or ovarian cancer (BOC). By new sequencing technologies, numerous variants of uncertain significance (VUS) are identified. It is mandatory to develop new tools to evaluate their functional impact and pathogenicity. As the expression of pathogenic BRCA1 variants in Saccharomyces cerevisiae increases the frequency of intra- and inter-chromosomal homologous recombination (HR), and gene reversion (GR), we validated the two HR and the GR assays by testing 23 benign and 23 pathogenic variants and compared the results with those that were obtained in the small colony phenotype (SCP) assay, an additional yeast-based assay, that was validated previously. We demonstrated that they scored high accuracy, sensitivity, and sensibility. By using a classifier that was based on majority of voting, we have integrated data from HR, GR, and SCP assays and developed a reliable method, named yBRCA1, with high sensitivity to obtain an accurate VUS functional classification (benign or pathogenic). The classification of BRCA1 variants, important for assessing the risk of developing BOC, is often difficult to establish with genetic methods because they occur rarely in the population. This study provides a new tool to get insights on the functional impact of the BRCA1 variants.
abstract_zh: BRCA1基因的种系突变已被报道会增加患乳腺癌和/或卵巢癌（BOC）的终生风险。通过新的测序技术，已鉴定出大量意义不确定的变异（VUS）。因此，必须开发新工具来评估其功能影响和致病性。由于在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中表达致病性BRCA1变异会增加染色体内和染色体间同源重组（HR）及基因回复（GR）的频率，我们通过测试23个良性变异和23个致病性变异验证了两种HR检测和GR检测，并将结果与先前已验证的另一种基于酵母的小菌落表型（SCP）检测结果进行了比较。我们证明这些检测具有高准确性、高敏感性和高特异性。通过使用基于多数投票的分类器，我们整合了HR、GR和SCP检测的数据，开发了一种名为yBRCA1的可靠方法，该方法具有高灵敏度，能够获得准确的VUS功能分类（良性或致病性）。BRCA1变异的分类对于评估BOC发病风险至关重要，但由于这些变异在人群中罕见，通常难以通过遗传学方法确定。本研究提供了一种新工具，以深入了解BRCA1变异的功能影响。
